title: Reclaiming Home: Black Altadena Rebuilds | Official Trailer
description: After the Eaton Fire swept through Altadena, the Black community there was faced with the loss of generational wealth, a cultural legacy and the bonds that tie neighborhoods together. For four families, the path to recovery and rebuilding has presented unique challenges and outcomes.  This 30 minute documentary will be released on July 30, 2026.
